dedupe_keys.name: water supply daily streamflow into melbourne s 4 major harvesting storage dams

description: Water Supply - Daily Streamflow (into Melbourne's 4 Major Harvesting Storage Dams) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Melbourne Water Corporation. This dataset provides daily measured streamflows into the four (4) major harvesting catchment dams in megalitres (ML). The streamflow is a calculated value which represents the observed 24-hour accumulated streamflow into the dam; net of any evaporation losses or rainfall gains from the dam surface. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Melbourne Water Corporation. Its tags are Open Data, catchment streamflows, dam levels, storage dams, volumes. It offers 11 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2025-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
